newsitem.title: JAPAN: Taiyo Yuden up on higher dividend, profits.
newsitem.headline: Taiyo Yuden up on higher dividend, profits.

text.p: Shares in Japan's Taiyo Yuden Co Ltd were up in Tokyo morning trade on Tuesday after a recent announcement that it would pay a higher annual dividend of 10 yen for the year to March 31, up from eight yen in 1995/96.

The Japanese manufacturer of electrolytic capacitors and ferrites also announced on Monday that it had raised its forecast for group net profits for 1996/97 to 7.7 billion yen from its earlier estimate of 6 billion yen.
As of 0138 GMT, Taiyo Yuden's shares were up 60 yen at 1,470 yen on a turnover of 921,000 shares. The company was among the top 30 percentage gainers on the first section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
